title: Memory Cell Interception
statement: The task is to count, for each read in two R/W strings (lengths up to 2·10^5) merged in every order-preserving way, how many distinct values it can see when a write at global step i stores i. Key reduction: the values form an interval union, one contiguous range once the reader's thread has written, otherwise 0 plus windows of length p (the read's index) starting at the other thread's writes.
